About Aroha Adventure Club

Aroha Adventure Club began in May 2024 with four people from Mulki who shared one dream: to take people from different places out on the trails and let them experience the joy of trekking.

What started as a small group of four has grown into a family of more than 110 members, and it is still growing with every adventure.
